name: Drawer AI
summary: AI electrical takeoff that detects devices on PDF drawings and routes conduit.
differentiator: Goes past counting to conduit routing and panel-to-circuit tag linking, and says it delivers a routed, priced takeoff. It does not say where the prices come from.
pricing: Starter and Enterprise annual subscriptions. Contact sales for pricing.

scope.takeoff: Detects power devices, lighting fixtures and panel schedules on PDFs, links panels, circuits and tags, and routes conduit.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: The page says "a fully routed, priced takeoff" but names no price source.

bestFor: Commercial shops that want conduit routing as part of takeoff.
skipIf: You want a price on the page.
